lines.text: It was fifty-six.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: But in games? In games, you're fearless. [pause] Because in a game, when you fall... you just respawn.
lines.text: But in games? In games, you're fearless. Because in a game, when you fall... you just respawn.

lines.raw: [deadpan] Real life does not have that feature. [pause] You checked.
lines.text: Real life does not have that feature. You checked.

lines.text: At home, there's Dad. He makes pancakes every morning... and the same joke every morning.

lines.text: Why did the pancake go to the doctor? Because it was feeling a little... FLAT!

lines.text: Mistakes are how we get laughed at.

lines.text: And then there's Ivy. Your best friend since kindergarten. She builds inventions. They explode. A lot.

lines.speaker: IVY

lines.text: TIP: Don't press "Leave Game."

lines.text: Ooooh... I am the KIIING... of the breakfaaast!

lines.text: And it was. Because for the first time in your life... messing up didn't matter.

lines.speaker: IVY

lines.raw: [proud] Why did the pancake go to the—

lines.raw: Respawning.

lines.raw: Respawning.

lines.text: Fail number three hundred and thirteen. Let's make it a good one.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: So you did something you had never done before. [pause] You kept going.
lines.text: So you did something you had never done before. You kept going.

lines.speaker: KID
lines.raw: [chanting] FOAM! FOAM! FOAM! FOAM!
lines.text: FOAM! FOAM! FOAM! FOAM!

lines.speaker: MOM
lines.raw: [cheering, laughing] I'm sending this to the WHOLE family!
lines.text: I'm sending this to the WHOLE family!

lines.speaker: BEA
lines.raw: [tiny voice, shouting] THAT'S MY BROTHER! [pause] He's a mushroom!
lines.text: THAT'S MY BROTHER! He's a mushroom!

lines.speaker: PRINCIPAL
lines.raw: [foamy, deadpan] ...Best. Disaster. Ever.
lines.text: ...Best. Disaster. Ever.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: You didn't win. [pause] The girl with seven bowling pins won. [pause] Honestly? Fair.
lines.text: You didn't win. The girl with seven bowling pins won. Honestly? Fair.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: [laughing, covered in foam] We got "Most Unforgettable"!
lines.text: We got "Most Unforgettable"!

lines.speaker: IVY
lines.raw: [laughing] See? Told you! The mess-up IS the fun part!
lines.text: See? Told you! The mess-up IS the fun part!

lines.speaker: DAD
lines.raw: [proud] Okay, brand new one! Why did the waffle go to school? [pause] To be more... well-rounded!
lines.text: Okay, brand new one! Why did the waffle go to school? To be more... well-rounded!

lines.speaker: BEA
lines.raw: [tiny voice] Waffles are square.
lines.text: Waffles are square.

lines.speaker: DAD
lines.raw: [deflating] ...I'm gonna need a minute.
lines.text: ...I'm gonna need a minute.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: [laughing] Dad, that's the worst joke ever. [pause] I LOVE it.
lines.text: Dad, that's the worst joke ever. I LOVE it.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: [confident] Sixty-four!
lines.text: Sixty-four!

lines.speaker: TEACHER
lines.raw: [deadpan] ...Sixty-three.
lines.text: ...Sixty-three.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: You were wrong. [pause] And it was fine.
lines.text: You were wrong. And it was fine.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: You tried the skateboard trick again. For real this time. [pause] Attempt one... [pause] Ouch.
lines.text: You tried the skateboard trick again. For real this time. Attempt one... Ouch.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: [laughing, getting up] Attempt TWO!
lines.text: Attempt TWO!

lines.speaker: IVY
lines.raw: [warm] Every inventor needs one.
lines.text: Every inventor needs one.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.raw: [writing, smiling] Fail number one. Talent show. [pause] Lesson learned: totally worth it.
lines.text: Fail number one. Talent show. Lesson learned: totally worth it.

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.raw: [whispering] Checkpoint saved.
lines.text: Checkpoint saved.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: [playful] Gary saw the whole thing. [pause] And now... Gary wants a turn.
lines.text: Gary saw the whole thing. And now... Gary wants a turn.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.raw: [warmly] So... if you could respawn just once, what would YOU redo? [pause] Tell me in the comments! [pause] And remember... one life. Make it count.
lines.text: So... if you could respawn just once, what would YOU redo? Tell me in the comments! And remember... one life. Make it count.
